plan.title: Automate source-bound release packaging

criteria.description: Use the existing committed-source build to create exactly five platform archives and SHA256SUMS with approved regular members, source revision, version and Go build metadata. Refuse unsafe candidate contents and existing output.
Pass the eight source isolation regressions, packaging success and rejection tests and a temporary native install smoke against a fresh archive with the expected binary version and source revision.

limitations: Local unpublished artifacts only. Cross-build and checksum success do not establish native execution or bitwise reproducibility. Actual archive signing and publication belong to subsequent tasks.
